_doc: Curated technique seeds (knowledge_architecture.md section 5), one file per area. Fields: id, level + scope (a scope node or universal), aliases (v1 / technique-DB / footer names folded in), mechanism, preconditions (predicate DSL), predicts (canonical metric -> up|down|flat|up_or_flat|down_or_flat), risks (pitfalls), states / op_classes / op_kinds gates (empty = any), slot (offered by the multi-slot agent), prior {mean, n}: a seed prior with a low pseudo-count that evidence overrides, realizations by scope (target:<key> | target:<backend>:sm_NN+ | target:<backend> | node:<id> | universal). Loaded by Ontology.seed(); scripts/seed_knowledge.py builds a knowledge.db from these files.

techniques.mechanism: a grid sized to the machine, each thread looping over wide elements: full bandwidth with minimal index math and launch cost

realizations.how: Grid-stride loop with float4 accesses (half2 x4 for fp16); grid = a few waves of the SM count; minimal integer math per element.
Global size = a few waves per SP, each work-item loops over vload4 elements.

techniques.mechanism: an operand broadcast along some dimensions (bias, per-channel scale) is loaded once per thread / block and reused, not re-read per element

realizations.how: Order the mapping so a thread works within one channel / row and keeps the broadcast value in a register (or the block stages the per-channel vector in on-chip memory).

techniques.mechanism: transpose / permute through a padded on-chip tile so both the read and the write are coalesced

realizations.how: 32x32 tiles in on-chip memory padded to 33 columns: read rows coalesced, sync, write columns coalesced.
Segment loads/stores (vlseg/vsseg) or strided vlse into registers, then unit-stride stores.

techniques.mechanism: gathers / index_select / scatter: threads over the contiguous inner dimension of each gathered row, the index read once per row
risks: scatter with duplicate indices needs atomics or a deterministic order

realizations.how: A block (or warp) per gathered row: read the index once, copy the row with vectorised coalesced loads; for scatter, atomics only when indices can repeat.
Indexed loads (vluxei32) only when rows are short; otherwise unit-stride copy per gathered row.

techniques.mechanism: concatenation writes every input in one launch through an offset table, with vectorised copies

realizations.how: One kernel over the output: each thread finds its source tensor from a small offset table (binary search or per-block assignment) and copies float4 runs.

techniques.mechanism: outputs that are never re-read bypass the caches, so they do not evict reused inputs

realizations.how: __stcs() / st.global.cs for write-once outputs (and __ldcs for read-once inputs).
Write full cache lines in order so no read-for-ownership is needed; avoid partial-line tails.
